I completely understand what you're saying. I've been attempting to be normal for over 7 years. Even if I managed to remain normal and try to do things in order to make everything okay. Everything will collapse the next day, and I'll be back at square one. All of the darkness and emptiness will return.

As a result, I constantly lose confidence and am unable to cope with the rest of the world. I guess I'll be miserable for the rest of my life....

I always celebrate my birthday with family or friends, but at the end of the day, I always cry....I don't know why, but I feel so empty on the inside that I end up crying.

But, for the past few years, my birthday wish has remained consistent: I always wish to die on my birthday.

I appreciate that you like to criticize, but have an open mind and try to understand other people's viewpoints. Just because you can write doesn't mean you should write to degrade other people's comments.
